about: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm (a Yamaha C5 concert grand), CC BY 3.0: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3 . One note every three semitones, A1 to C6, as hosted by Tone.js (https://tonejs.github.io/audio/salamander/); each made mono, its lead-in trimmed, 3 s long with a 0.7 s fade, its peak set to -3 dB, Opus 32 kbps. Made by tools/make-piano.sh.
